```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)       
library(nnet)          
library(randomForest)
library(skimr)
library(tidymodels)
library(GGally)


tidymodels::tidymodels_prefer()
set.seed(20251212)

# Read data 
fetal_raw <- read_csv("fetal_health.csv")

# Clean column names: 'baseline value' -> baseline_value, etc.
fetal <- fetal_raw %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(
    fetal_health = factor(
      fetal_health,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3),
      labels = c("Normal", "Suspect", "Pathological")
    )
  )

glimpse(fetal)

# missingness check
fetal %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "var", values_to = "n_missing") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_missing)) %>%
  print(n = 50)
```

## EDA
```{r}
# outcome distribution
fetal %>%
  count(fetal_health) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))

fetal %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = fetal_health, fill = fetal_health)) +
  geom_bar() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = rev(hcl.colors(3, "RdYlGn")),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Fetal health (target class)",
    y = "Count",
    title = "Class distribution: Normal / Suspect / Pathological"
  )


# summary of predictors
fetal %>%
  select(-fetal_health) %>%
  summary()
```


```{r, fig.width=18, fig.height=18}
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)

# correlation matrix (predictors only)
X <- fetal %>% select(-fetal_health)
C <- cor(X, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

cor_long <- as.data.frame(C) %>%
  rownames_to_column("var1") %>%
  pivot_longer(-var1, names_to = "var2", values_to = "r")

cor_long <- cor_long %>%
  mutate(
    var1 = factor(var1, levels = colnames(C)),
    var2 = factor(var2, levels = colnames(C))
  ) %>%
  filter(as.integer(var1) <= as.integer(var2))

ggplot(cor_long, aes(var2, var1, fill = r)) +
  geom_tile() +
  coord_equal() +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = hcl.colors(20, "RdYlGn")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 14)) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 14)) +
  labs(title = "Predictor Correlations", x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "r") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9)
  )
```
## Train/test split (stratified)
```{r}
split_obj <- initial_split(fetal, prop = 0.80, strata = fetal_health)
train_dat <- training(split_obj)
test_dat  <- testing(split_obj)

train_dat %>% count(fetal_health) %>% mutate(prop = n/sum(n))
test_dat  %>% count(fetal_health) %>% mutate(prop = n/sum(n))
```
```{r, fig.height=8}
vars_to_plot <- c("baseline_value",
                  "accelerations",
                  "uterine_contractions",
                  "light_decelerations",
                  "prolongued_decelerations",
                  "abnormal_short_term_variability",
                  "mean_value_of_short_term_variability",
                  "percentage_of_time_with_abnormal_long_term_variability",
                  "mean_value_of_long_term_variability")

fetal %>%
  select(fetal_health, all_of(vars_to_plot)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-fetal_health, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = fetal_health, y = value, fill = fetal_health)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = rev(hcl.colors(3, "RdYlGn")), guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "Predictor distributions by class", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()
```


## Preprocessing recipe
```{r}
rec_scaled <- recipe(fetal_health ~ ., data = train_dat) %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

rec_unscaled <- recipe(fetal_health ~ ., data = train_dat) %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors())

folds <- vfold_cv(train_dat, v = 5, strata = fetal_health)

my_metrics <- metric_set(accuracy, bal_accuracy)
```

## Fit models
### Multinomial logistic regression
```{r}
multinom_spec <- multinom_reg() %>%
  set_mode("classification") %>%
  set_engine("nnet", trace = FALSE)

multinom_wf <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(rec_scaled) %>%
  add_model(multinom_spec)

multinom_fit <- fit(multinom_wf, data = train_dat)
```



### Random forest
```{r}
rf_spec <- rand_forest(trees = 1000) %>%
  set_mode("classification") %>%
  set_engine("ranger", importance = "impurity")

rf_wf <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(rec_unscaled) %>%
  add_model(rf_spec)

rf_fit <- fit(rf_wf, data = train_dat)
```

### Penalized multinomial (glmnet)
```{r}
glmnet_spec <- multinom_reg(penalty = tune(), mixture = tune()) %>%
  set_mode("classification") %>%
  set_engine("glmnet")

glmnet_wf <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(rec_scaled) %>%
  add_model(glmnet_spec)

set.seed(20251212)
glmnet_grid <- grid_regular(
  penalty(range = c(-4, 0)),  
  mixture(range = c(0, 1)),
  levels = 6
)

glmnet_res <- tune_grid(
  glmnet_wf,
  resamples = folds,
  grid = glmnet_grid,
  metrics = my_metrics,
  control = control_grid(save_pred = TRUE)
)

collect_metrics(glmnet_res)
best_glmnet <- select_best(glmnet_res, metric = "bal_accuracy")
best_glmnet
```


### XGboost
```{r}
xgb_spec <- boost_tree(
  trees = tune(),
  tree_depth = tune(),
  learn_rate = tune(),
  loss_reduction = tune(),
  sample_size = tune(),
  mtry = tune(),
  min_n = tune()
) %>%
  set_mode("classification") %>%
  set_engine("xgboost")

xgb_wf <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(rec_unscaled) %>%  
  add_model(xgb_spec)

set.seed(20251212)
xgb_grid <- grid_latin_hypercube(
  trees(range = c(300, 1200)),
  tree_depth(),
  learn_rate(range = c(-4, -1)),  
  loss_reduction(),
  sample_size = sample_prop(),
  mtry(range = c(3, ncol(train_dat) - 1)),
  min_n(),
  size = 25
)

xgb_res <- tune_grid(
  xgb_wf,
  resamples = folds,
  grid = xgb_grid,
  metrics = my_metrics,
  control = control_grid(save_pred = TRUE)
)

collect_metrics(xgb_res)
best_xgb <- select_best(xgb_res, metric = "bal_accuracy")
best_xgb
```

## Evaluate models on test set
```{r}
# Helper function: class-specific sensitivity from a confusion matrix
class_sensitivity <- function(cm) {
  m <- as.matrix(cm$table)  
  tibble(
    class = rownames(m),
    sensitivity = diag(m) / rowSums(m)
  )
}

# Multinomial logistic regression performance
multinom_pred <- predict(multinom_fit, test_dat, type = "class") %>%
  bind_cols(test_dat %>% select(fetal_health))

multinom_acc <- accuracy(multinom_pred, truth = fetal_health, estimate = .pred_class)

multinom_cm <- conf_mat(multinom_pred, truth = fetal_health, estimate = .pred_class)

multinom_sens <- class_sensitivity(multinom_cm) %>%
  filter(class %in% c("Suspect", "Pathological"))

multinom_acc
multinom_sens

autoplot(multinom_cm, type = "heatmap") +
  labs(title = "Multinomial Logistic Regression: Confusion Matrix")

# Random forest performance
rf_pred <- predict(rf_fit, test_dat, type = "class") %>%
  bind_cols(test_dat %>% select(fetal_health))

rf_acc <- accuracy(rf_pred, truth = fetal_health, estimate = .pred_class)

rf_cm <- conf_mat(rf_pred, truth = fetal_health, estimate = .pred_class)

rf_sens <- class_sensitivity(rf_cm) %>%
  filter(class %in% c("Suspect", "Pathological"))

rf_acc
rf_sens

autoplot(rf_cm, type = "heatmap") +
  labs(title = "Random Forest: Confusion Matrix")

# Random Forest variable importance
rf_fit_obj <- extract_fit_parsnip(rf_fit)$fit
imp <- sort(rf_fit_obj$variable.importance, decreasing = TRUE)

tibble(variable = names(imp), importance = as.numeric(imp)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(variable, importance), y = importance)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Random Forest: Top 15 variable importances", x = NULL, y = "Importance") +
  theme_minimal()

# glmnet performance
glmnet_final_wf <- finalize_workflow(glmnet_wf, best_glmnet)
glmnet_fit <- fit(glmnet_final_wf, data = train_dat)

glmnet_pred <- predict(glmnet_fit, test_dat, type = "class") %>%
  bind_cols(test_dat %>% select(fetal_health))

glmnet_acc <- accuracy(glmnet_pred, truth = fetal_health, estimate = .pred_class)
glmnet_cm  <- conf_mat(glmnet_pred, truth = fetal_health, estimate = .pred_class)
glmnet_sens <- class_sensitivity(glmnet_cm) %>%
  filter(class %in% c("Suspect", "Pathological"))

glmnet_acc
glmnet_sens
autoplot(glmnet_cm, type = "heatmap") +
  labs(title = "Penalized Multinomial (glmnet): Confusion Matrix")

# XGBoost performance
xgb_final_wf <- finalize_workflow(xgb_wf, best_xgb)
xgb_fit <- fit(xgb_final_wf, data = train_dat)

xgb_pred <- predict(xgb_fit, test_dat, type = "class") %>%
  bind_cols(test_dat %>% select(fetal_health))

xgb_acc <- accuracy(xgb_pred, truth = fetal_health, estimate = .pred_class)
xgb_cm  <- conf_mat(xgb_pred, truth = fetal_health, estimate = .pred_class)
xgb_sens <- class_sensitivity(xgb_cm) %>%
  filter(class %in% c("Suspect", "Pathological"))

xgb_acc
xgb_sens
autoplot(xgb_cm, type = "heatmap") +
  labs(title = "XGBoost: Confusion Matrix")

# XGBoost variable importance
xgb_fit_obj <- extract_fit_parsnip(xgb_fit)$fit
xgb_imp <- xgb.importance(model = xgb_fit_obj)

# Turn into tibble and plot top 15 by Gain
xgb_imp %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  slice_max(Gain, n = 15) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Feature, Gain), y = Gain)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "XGBoost: Top 15 variable importances",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Gain"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


## Side-by-side model comparison
```{r}
bind_rows(
  multinom_acc %>% mutate(model = "Multinomial (nnet)"),
  rf_acc       %>% mutate(model = "Random forest"),
  glmnet_acc   %>% mutate(model = "Penalized multinomial (glmnet)"),
  xgb_acc      %>% mutate(model = "XGBoost")
) %>%
  select(model, .metric, .estimate) %>%
  arrange(desc(.estimate))

bind_rows(
  multinom_sens %>% mutate(model = "Multinomial (nnet)"),
  rf_sens       %>% mutate(model = "Random forest"),
  glmnet_sens   %>% mutate(model = "Penalized multinomial (glmnet)"),
  xgb_sens      %>% mutate(model = "XGBoost")
) %>%
  select(model, class, sensitivity) %>%
  arrange(class, desc(sensitivity))
```
